title: Pikmin Game Gets Short Film Series
content:
Nintendo announced on Saturday during a livestream that November 1 is now " Pikmin Day," and announced a new short movie series based on the game titled Hello! Pikmin . The short series' first episode premiered during the stream, and the second episode also debuted on Monday. The next episode will debut later this month, and one new episode will be released every month starting in December.

Hello! Pikmin episode 1

Hello! Pikmin episode 2

In addition, the livestream featured a new demo video of the new Dandori Academy mode included in the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2 edition of Pikmin 4 . The game's Switch 2 version and the Dandori Academy mode will launch on November 12. A free demo version is launching on Monday.

Nintendo also revealed the new "Secret Caves" feature for the franchise 's Pikmin Bloom game, that will launch this winter.

The Pikmin series of strategy games allows players to control creatures called Pikmin in an effort to explore an unknown planet and survive against predatory adversaries, using the special properties of each kind of Pikmin to navigate the game environment.

Nintendo released the first game in the series on the Nintendo GameCube in 2001. Nintendo released Pikmin 3 , on the Wii U in 2013. The side-scrolling action-adventure game Hey! Pikmin shipped for Nintendo 3DS in July 2017 in Japan, North America, and Europe. Nintendo released the Pikmin 3 Deluxe version for the Switch in 2020. Pokémon GO developer Niantic released the free-to-play AR (augmented reality) game Pikmin Bloom worldwide in October 2021. The Pikmin 4 game shipped for the Switch in July 2023.

title: 30 Years Later, This Classic Isekai Anime Should Be Much Bigger
content:
While the current anime industry is heavily dominated by battle shonen such as Jujutsu Kaisen and Demon Slayer , the medium offers more than just one specific type of story. Despite the popularity of the isekai genre, not many series are critically acclaimed, which makes it even harder to find a good show or movie to watch. This is especially true when the genre itself has so many categories, and each of them offers something unique that may or may not appeal to potential viewers. However, whenever there’s talk about the most acclaimed and underrated isekai series of all time, The Vision of Escaflowne would always be mentioned. The series was released in the 1990s, the revolutionary era of the anime and manga industry.

Unfortunately, just like most classics from that decade, the anime failed to stand the test of time. Originally released in April 1996, the short anime reached its conclusion on September 24th, 2026, without ever returning with a sequel. Despite offering a unique premise and exceptional storytelling as both an isekai and a mecha series, it never adapted its complete story. Even though this original anime series had a fairly satisfying conclusion, there are still some plot points it could have explored thanks to its expansive world-building and a promising cast.

The Vision of Escaflowne Remains One of the Most Underrated Isekai Classics

This critically acclaimed 1990s classic is a fantasia that blends together isekai, romance, and mecha duels. The story centers around Hitomu Kanzaki, an ordinary high school girl who always had a profound interest in mysticism. Strange dreams trouble her at night as they keep showing her the images of a mysterious temple, a tremendous jewel, and a shadowy prince. Not to mention that a strange incantation keeps echoing in her mind. On one fateful day, during a simple fortune-telling at school, she is pulled into the world of Gaea, where Earth is visible in the sky like a second moon. It doesn’t take long for her to get entangled in the fate of Van Fanel, who pilots a legendary mecha known as Escaflowne. The duo fights against the Zaibach Empire together to stop them from altering fate with the use of a reality-manipulating technology.

The anime was originally released in Japan in 1996 before it aired on Fox Kids in 2000 with heavy editing and modification as compared to the original series. Unfortunately, many of these cuts severely altered the flow of the story, and it became one of the most egregious examples of Fox Kids’ version of the anime completely cutting Episode 1 from its televised run in the U.S. One of the worst parts of the new version was that it cut in multiple flashback sequences to make up for other scenes being removed.

The Vision of Escaflowne Deserves a Reboot With a Longer Run

Not many fans know that the anime was originally conceived as a 39-episode series , but director Kazuki Akane had to compress their planned storyline into just 26 episodes due to budget issues. The finale wraps up the conflict with the Zaibach Empire, resolving the core mysteries of Gaea and the titular mecha. It also brings the primary character arcs to a definitive close. However, the shortened episode count led to a compressed final act that rushed certain storylines and character developments that could’ve been handled way better in a longer run. This is why a reboot could finally realize the complete vision, giving proper time to elements like the relationship between Hitomi and her potential romantic interests.

Additionally, the story also needs more room to explore Van’s development as a ruler and the complex political landscape of Gaea. While the anime returned with a movie in 2000, it focused on retelling the same story instead of continuing it or adapting the scenes that couldn’t be included due to the shorter episode count. After three decades, the anime is being more or less forgotten, especially since it’s no longer available to stream anywhere in the U.S. Luckily, reboots have often been proven successful when it comes to attracting new viewers. The visuals from the 1990s were surely iconic, but the newer animation visuals with the advancement in technology would be even more beneficial to get fans’ attention.

Do you think The Vision of Escaflowne deserves more recognition among classic isekai anime? What part of the anime makes it stand out to you? Let us know your thoughts in the comments below!

title: The Beginning After the End Creator Confirms Hiatus After Major Platform Shutdown
content:
The future of The Beginning After the End looks bleak after Tapas announced its shutdown in October, 2026. The web novel has been publishing on the platform in 2017 and only a year later, it received a webtoon adaptation. While the novel reached its conclusion in November last year, the webtoon had a huge chunk of story left to adapt. Unfortunately, things changed for the worse last month after the unexpected shutdown of the platform. The series has always been exclusive to Tapas, one of the biggest webtoon and novel platforms. The platform was acquired by Kakao Entertainment in 2023, but it could barely survive three years before the South Korean company decided to close it forever.

Starting last month, readers can’t buy any more inks, and they can only use their existing inks before March 31st, 2027. Not only that, but the platform made no such promise of the readers being able to access the series they already bought. Manta announced that anything that readers have bought on Tapas can be accessed on their platform only if its available in their library. Unfortunately, while it’s a nice initiative from Manta, it doesn’t apply to exclusive series like The Beginning After the End , which why the creator announced an indefinite hiatus.

The Beginning After the End Creator Announced Indefinite Hiatus

Only three weeks after Tapas announced it will shutdown, Turtle Me shared on his official X handle that the series will be going on a hiatus starting October 29th, 2026 after the release of Chapter 259. The creator opens up about the uncertain future of the webtoon, “I wish I had more more information to share, but the honest truth is, I don’t have any answers yet about what comes next. I’m still working to get them, and I’ll keep working until I do.”

The creator also thanked fans for spending their remaining inks on the series and urged them to do the same for their favorite creators. The shutdown of a major platform like Tapas with a wide range of exclusively original series, including those from indie creators, is a huge loss to the web novel and webtoon industry. The platform is also home to several popular and ongoing series that fans can’t read anywhere else. Even with the controversial anime adaptation, TBATE has only grown more popular over the years. However, it’s only because the series is that popular that fans are expecting it will get another new platform soon enough. For now, however, there’s no telling how long it will take, which is why the series will remain on indefinite hiatus.

The Beginning After the End Anime Has Yet to Confirm Season 3

While the webtoon’s future looks bleak, the anime may not be getting another season at all. The first season of the anime was released in April last year as part of the Spring 2025 lineup and it drew attention for all the wrong reasons. Since this isekai already has a huge global fan base, fans were more than excited for the anime adaptation but it ended up becoming a massive disappointment. Whether it was the visuals or the stiff action scenes, nothing about the anime was praiseworthy.

The controversy was so extreme that tens of thousands of fans signed a petition to cancel the series . However, not only did the anime survive the ordeal, but it also confirmed a second season. The second season was released in April this year, and while the adaptation was slightly better than before, it failed to attract fans. Even though the anime season wrapped up in June this year, a third season hasn’t been officially confirmed yet. Considering the controversy and poor viewership, it wouldn’t be surprising if the anime never returned with a sequel.

How do you feel about the hiatus? What are your hopes for the series when it eventually returns? Share your thoughts in the comments below!

title: 3 Manga That Fans Ranked Higher Than One Piece in 2026
content:
One Piece continued its epic narrative in 2026, yet three other series still managed to rank above it according to fans. Eiichiro Oda’s manga has consistently released new chapters for more than a decade, continuing to engage longtime fans and attract new readers every year. It has also become the highest-selling comic of all time, surpassing even Superman in sales.

However, fans have had a different take on One Piece this year. One of the most active anime and manga communities is MyAnimeList. On the website, three manga series have ranked higher than One Piece this year, including two dark classics and one shonen manga that has received a boost thanks to its recent anime adaptation.

3) Vagabond

The manga series ranking just above One Piece in third place on MyAnimeList, with a score of 9.27, is Takehiko Inoue’s Vagabond . This seinen manga first debuted in 1998, just a year after One Piece began. The story follows Miyamoto Musashi on a journey to find meaning in life rather than simply becoming a stronger swordsman. With its protagonist based on the real-life Miyamoto Musashi , the series does an excellent job of capturing the intrigue surrounding the legendary samurai.

It does so with its own interpretations of other historical figures, including Sasaki Kojiro, making the manga stand out even more. The series has yet to reach its conclusion, and it is also a shame that it still hasn’t received an anime adaptation. However, the fact that fans continue to rate it higher than One Piece on one of the biggest anime communities is an achievement in itself.

2) JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run

Hirohiko Araki’s JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run is a surprisingly high entry on this list, with a score of 9.34, making it the second-highest-ranked manga on the website. However, considering the cult following the franchise has built across its many parts and the fact that the Steel Ball Run anime adaptation premiered in March and is continuing its run in the fall this year , it is no surprise that fans are once again showcasing their love for the series.

This part of the franchise is also one of its most distinctive, as it revolves around a horse race, undoubtedly amplifying the series’ signature bizarreness. However, one of the reasons behind its rise in the rankings is the anime adaptation. Its lengthy premiere in March generated intrigue among fans, and after experiencing the first part, many were seemingly driven to explore the manga, helping it climb the rankings on the fan community website.

1) Berserk

The manga that has conquered the top spot among manga series in 2026 is one that began its run even before One Piece and is still yet to reach its conclusion. Kentaro Miura’s dark fantasy manga, Berserk , sits at the top with a score of 9.46 on MyAnimeList. This is an unparalleled feat, especially considering that the series’ original author passed away in 2021 . The manga has continued under a new team dedicated to carrying forward the legacy Miura created, with a new arc underway and fresh chapters still being released for fans to enjoy.

Its position at the top of MyAnimeList is a testament to its impact. There is arguably no manga darker than Berserk , even in modern times when more shonen series are embracing darker elements. It is a story about friendship, love, and war, all amplified by its dark fantasy setting to deliver a gut-wrenching narrative centered on its protagonist, Guts. Berserk will likely hold its position as the highest-rated manga among fans as more chapters are released, and One Piece may have a hard time catching up, not just in 2026 but in the years to come, to reclaim the top spot.

title: Dragon Ball’s Best Version of Bardock Isn’t the One You Think
content:
Bardock, the father of Goku, appeared in numerous Dragon Ball franchise TV anime and movies and had a wide range of personality traits in canon and non-canon outings. It’s time to set the record straight and state that Xenoverse Bardock proved the best blend of all the other characterizations. Yes, his appearances are brief, and doesn’t have the same deep dive on his backstory. But hopefully, the evidence here will help sway opinion.

Xeno Bardock is obviously not part of the official canon, but his moral code, higher power levels and survival in his timeline make for a much deeper storyline. Much like Broly, Bardock was changed from a cold, violent Saiyan in the now non-canon Dragon Ball Z: Bardock – The Father of Goku to a compassionate, loving father and husband that did all he could for Goku in Dragon Ball Super: Broly . Unfortunately for both timelines, he got a swift, unceremonious ending when Frieza blew up Planet Vegeta. That wasn’t the case for Xeno Bardock.

Bardock’s Extra Lifeline Opens Door For More

Xenoverse Bardock escaped the unfortunate doom that his timeline brethren fell prey to. Instead of dying with the rest of the Saiyans during Frieza’s planet-destroying attack, he was saved by a temporal anomaly, similar to a wormhole, that teleports him to another dimension. A deserved save in some ways considering most of the Saiyans at that time were brutal killing machines . Bardock was much more of an outlier. or at worst, and anti-hero by comparison.

Bardock’s original timeline from 1990 didn’t differentiate much from the ruthless Saiyan path. He was a cold, distant mercenary that had little similarities to his world-saving son. It’s a complicated web because he was so different from his son, but still puts up a fight against the evil Frieza before succumbing to the superior warrior. The canonical version seen with Dragon Ball Super: Broly is much more similar to Goku, however. He cares for his wife Gine and shows a love for Goku.

Those two stories definitely have their draws, but Xeno Bardock is the one with the biggest expansion opportunity, even if it’s not in a canon format. He grew to be an extremely accomplished warrior as noted by his ascension to Super Saiyan 4 . He was counted out and considered a lower class warrior just like his son but made his own way.

From Mind-Controlled Madman To Hero

Super Dragon Ball Heroes introduces him as the Masked Saiyan, and an opponent of the Z Fighters . Bardock is under evil mind control, but is eventually freed. He then joins the Time Patrol, a group that keeps timelines in check and tries to find and defeat evil travelers. It’s a great side mission story in its own right that could be explored further in the future. It’s another step in Bardock becoming a “good” Saiyan, which may sound weird to some. However, it’s a difficult journey for a warrior that used to conquer planets for something as trivial as money.

Unlike Goku being raised amongst good role models, Bardock basically had to become a hero on his own merit. He later proves a key component in defeating Dark King Demigra, with a three-generation Kamehameha . Goku is getting pummeled by a large energy blast but with the help of Gohan and then Xeno Bardock, they turn the tables on the Dark King. A nice moment between the three family members, even if the grandfather is from an entirely different dimension.

There’s still plenty to dig into with his storyline as he’s another new hero that the fanbase can latch onto. But who cares if it never becomes canon? It’s a fun story and not everything has to be a part of the official canon to be great. Dragon Ball has had many great stories that no longer exist in its official timeline now. The franchise also has a lot of starts to storylines only to come back around to the subject later, so anything is possible, just like Future Trunks’ return . Do you think Xenoverse Bardock deserves more of a run and is the best story of Goku’s father so far? Let us know in the comments.

The franchise also has a lot of starts to storylines only to come back around to the subject later, so anything is possible, just like Future Trunks’ return . Do you think Xenoverse Bardock deserves more of a run and is the best story of Goku’s father so far? Let us know in the comments.

title: New Dragon Ball Super Remake Just Powered Up Super Saiyan God Goku’s Debut – Watch
content:
Dragon Ball Super is now working through a new remake of the now classic TV anime series this Fall, and the newest episode just powered up Super Saiyan God Goku’s debut with a new take on the original ritual that brought it to life. Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is an enhanced version of the original Dragon Ball Super TV anime , and the newest episode finally saw Goku and the other Saiyans gather together for the Super Saiyan God ritual. Which had been the most anticipated moment of this first arc yet.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is offering the third take on the Battle of Gods arc following the Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods movie and Dragon Ball Super TV anime series, and that means yet another updated take on the Super Saiyan God ritual. The enhanced effects seen with other transformations is here as well, but it makes all the more sense for the Super Saiyan God form’s debut. Check it out below as shared by @DBPerfectShots on X .

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode 4 Debuts Super Saiyan God Goku

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode 5 continues its way through the Battle of Gods arc as those on Earth had been trying to stall Beerus and keep him destroying the Earth. Luckily they are able to do so enough for Goku to arrive on the scene, and he has a plan to activate the Super Saiyan God form. By wishing on the Dragon Balls, Goku and the others discover a ritual that takes five pure hearted Saiyans to pour their souls into a sixth one in order to bring about the Super Saiyan God. And this ritual ends up working as the episode comes to an end.

The fight between Beerus and Super Saiyan God Goku is the marquee event of the Battle of Gods arc, and that’s set to truly begin with the next episode. But Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has begun to worry fans a bit as it’s not really clear what the team deems worthy enough to enhance, and what to trim away from other episodes . Because ideally, the ritual and the start of the fight could have started within the same episode. Or at least spent more time with the ritual instead of some of the elements that fans didn’t like in the TV anime like the Rock Paper Scissors stand off with Oolong.

What’s Next for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ?

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is likely going to work through the fight between Beerus and Goku over the next two episodes, then it’ll be off to the Resurrection F and Universe 6 arcs that have been confirmed for the remake thus far. It’s yet to be revealed how many episodes this new remake series will be running for thus far, nor has it been revealed if the anime’s other arcs will eventually get their own remake treatment ( especially when it comes to the Future Trunks arc ).

It’s also not quite clear how the series is going to choose to enhance these future arcs. Dragon Ball Super: Beerus features retooled scenes, new animation cuts, new visual effects, sound design and more, but some of the stars behind the remake have revealed that they have not recorded any new audio for it so far. It might not be as “new” as we hope, so we’ll have to see how this major Beerus and Goku fight goes.

How do you like the new version of the Super Saiyan God Goku debut in Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ‘ newest episode? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

HT – @DBPerfectShots on X

title: Major Shonen Jump Creator Returns With New Series After 12 Years & It’s a Perfect Comeback
content:
A major creator from Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has returned to Shueisha’s Jump releases with a new manga release after 12 long years, and it’s a perfect comeback for the dark fantasy creator. Shonen Jump ‘s various magazines have seen some of the most notable creators from the past return for new projects in the past few years. While some creators are returning for new sequels or continuations , there are others who have kicked off a whole new story instead like Norihiro Yagi, the creator behind Claymore and more.

Norhiro Yagi was last seen in the pages of one of Shueisha’s magazines with the release of Claymore from 2001 to 2014. While the classic series has since disappeared due to its lack of new physical release or easily accessible anime following its removal from streaming platforms, Yagi has returned with the start of a new manga series with Shueisha’s Jump+ app. Titled Bartlet Fairy Basslet ( which you can find for free here with Viz Media ), it’s already looking to be a dark fantasy series fans will want to keep reading.

Claymore Creator Bartlet Fairy Basslet Debuts With Shonen Jump

Bartlet Fairy Basslet will seem a bit familiar to Claymore fans or those who have been following Yagi’s previous one-shot manga attempts , but it’s yet another dark fantasy world. Though it starts out in a much more grounded way, however, as two kingdoms have been in the midst of war for many years. Brunhilde is a Knight Captain who manages to deal the final blow to her greatest enemy to end the long war, but seemingly loses her own life in the process. Only to then find herself waking up in a strange land filled with monsters.

When Brunhilde rescues some young children from a monster, she discovers she’s still alive and in a world filled with magic. But rather than being transported to another world, it turns out she’s in her own world thousands of years after her fateful battle, and now the series will see her in the wake of such a reveal. It’s the start to a whole new kind of fantasy, and that makes it all the more intriguing considering how big of a hit Claymore was during its own peak. Even if it’s tough to revisit after all these years.

Claymore Was a True Shonen Jump Classic

Claymore doesn’t really get as much love as some of the other Shonen Jump hits also running at the same time it did, and unfortunately it’s been the same as the anime has been lost to time at least when it comes to potential legal streaming options for those who wanted to check it out. It’s a dark fantasy series that would be a perfect fit for a potential remake like we have seen for other long gone Shonen Jump hits lately , and would likely find a whole new audience who love those types of stories.

But thankfully with this new manga series now starting out its own run, there’s a chance that Norihiro Yagi will have much better luck with Shonen Jump this time around. It’s been quite a while since Yagi has worked with Shueisha on a long series, so we’ll just have to see how it works out with each new chapter. What do you think of Bartlet Fairy Basslet ‘s debut chapter? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: 27 Years Later, One Piece Has Finally Put the Zoro vs. Sanji Debate to Rest
content:
One Piece ‘s latest chapter finally establishes who Zoro and Sanji are as characters and what they represent as Straw Hats. Zoro and Sanji’s positions in the series and their rivalry have been among the most heated debates in the story. It all began in 1999, when the manga depicted the Arlong Park arc, where the two first fought together. Their dynamic established their positions as rivals, raising questions about who was stronger and who was more important to the Straw Hats. With Zoro consistently portraying himself as the stronger one, alongside his cool demeanour and the fact that he is the first mate, he has always been held in higher regard.

With the appearance of the God’s Knights and the revelation that Conqueror’s Haki is required to defeat them, Zoro’s position was further solidified. He had already hinted at possessing this ability, while Sanji had never been depicted as having it. However, the series is finally revealing Sanji’s position and giving him a much-needed power upgrade. Over the past few chapters, while Zoro learned to grasp Conqueror’s Haki , Sanji confronted his past and gained a major insight into himself. Now, with Sanji having grasped Conqueror’s Haki as well, the series has also revealed his position among the Straw Hats, what his place alongside Zoro means for the crew, and, more importantly, what they both mean to Luffy.

One Piece Chapter 1197 Finally Settles Zoro and Sanji’s Positions in the Straw Hat Crew

One Piece Chapter 1197, titled “Love Is Defense,” continues Sanji’s fight against Killingham as the former increasingly proves that he can indeed begin to grasp Conqueror’s Haki after accepting that he must defend himself rather than continue hurting himself. This has been Sanji’s entire motto, making it a perfect character upgrade for someone who has struggled with low self-esteem . Near the end of the chapter, as Sanji coats his leg with Supreme King Haki, finally proving that he can wield this power as well, his monologue states that while Zoro can be Luffy’s sword, he can be his shield. This one line is essentially enough to establish what these two characters will represent going forward.

It highlights that, as important as a sword is, a shield is equally important. With Sanji possessing a body that seemingly never breaks and a newfound resolve to stop hurting himself, he essentially becomes an unbreakable guard who will always put himself first in line to defend Luffy, even before the sword, by protecting him from enemy attacks. This establishes a defining role for the character, something many thought would not be possible after the revelation that Supreme King Haki was necessary. More importantly, it gives Sanji a more distinct identity within the crew. Zoro has always been the swordsman of the crew, while Sanji has been known as the cook with a fierce kick.

However, giving Sanji the role of the shield, proving that he will be the first to stand between Luffy and the enemy alongside Zoro, establishes his permanent position in the crew. This latest development in One Piece is particularly unique because it moves away from the debate over who is stronger between Sanji and Zoro . Instead, it proves that they are both equally important, with distinct roles among the Straw Hats and contributions that will help make Luffy the King of the Pirates. Honestly, One Piece couldn’t have handled this any better as giving one a stronger position than the other would have only kept the Zoro vs. Sanji debate alive, without ever providing a definitive answer.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms Official Name for New Avatar Form Seen in Finale
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens has officially come to an end for its debut season, and the team behind the series have revealed their name for Pavi’s new Avatar State power up seen in the final episodes. Avatar: Seven Havens made its debut this October with Paramount+, and has been a massive hit with Avatar Studios thus far . Part of it is the way it has been expanding its wider universe, and that’s now even truer than ever as Pavi has unlocked a powerful new state at her disposal as the Avatar.

Avatar: Seven Havens saw Pavi and Nisha dealing with this massive red force of negative energy throughout the animated series’ debut season , but upon figuring out that she can tap into her Root Chakra in the final episodes, Pavi is able to bend this energy at will. It looks like the Avatar State, but series executive producers Ethan Spaulding and Sehaj Sethi have confirmed to TV Insider that this new form is actually referred to by them as the “Chakra State.”

What Is Chakra State? Avatar: Seven Havens Producers Explain

When Pavi started to use this new ability in Avatar: Seven Havens ‘ final few episodes of its debut season, there was a mystery as to whether or not this could be an altered version of the Avatar State. With Korra severing the Avatar’s connection to the previous lineage, it means the Avatar State is not something Pavi or Nisha could tap into. Though she seemed to have a fleeting connection to the past Avatars as a part of this power up, Pavi has instead entered a new “Chakra State” as it was confirmed to not be the Avatar State.

“We’re revealing a new sort of state of being that the Avatar can enter,” Sehaj began explaining in terms of what the Chakra State actually is. “…it is specifically linked to opening your chakra, so that is what Pavi channels when she is interacting and manipulating the energy, and it does give her a little power up for a short time. A brief, brief time.” When asked if Nisha will eventually be able to do the same, the producers only coyly teased that fans will have to keep watching the show.

What’s Next for Avatar: Seven Havens ?

Avatar: Seven Havens ends its first season with Pavi unlocking her connection with the Root Chakra, and teases she has six other chakra paths to unlock for the rest of her journey. After leaving Ellora, Pavi is now setting out to the other Havens in order to figure out her chakra and save all of the other Havens that might be in trouble. Confirmed for four seasons in total, production for the third and fourth seasons of the animated series is already underway as there likely won’t be too much of a wait for new episodes.

Avatar: Seven Havens has yet to confirm a release date or window for Book 2 of its run as of this time, but it will also be running for 13 episodes much like this first season. With a new power up and more of Korra’s history to dig into , make sure to catch up with everything on Paramount+ in the meantime to be ready for what’s next. What do you think of the Chakra state so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

HT – TV Insider

title: After 9 Years, Black Clover Season 2 Goes All Out With Magna’s Big Win – Watch
content:
Black Clover Season 2 has been showing off some of the manga’s most anticipated fights after five years of waiting, but it’s been almost a decade for Magna Swing before he’s gotten as big of a moment as the win he gets in the latest episode. Black Clover Season 2 is working its way through the Spade Kingdom Raid arc of Yuki Tabata’s original manga series, and with it fans are getting to see some of the biggest fights in the series finally come to life in the anime.

Black Clover Season 2 has been speeding through the fights against the Dark Triad thus far with all sorts of fights to keep track of , and the latest episode took fans by surprise with the reveal that Zora and Magna were actually planning to take on Dante. With the debut of Magna’s impressive new spell, Soul Chain Deathmatch, Magna gets a much needed win that has been building since his very first outing. You can check out an impressive clip from the episode below.

Black Clover Season 2 Impresses With Magna vs. Dante Fight

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 is titled “The Highest vs. The Lowest ,” and sees Magna and Zora come to Jack the Ripper’s rescue against Dante. Not believing that the two of them had anything that could harm him, Magna uses the opportunity to attach his new spell to Dante, Soul Chain Deathmatch. Working together with Zora for the last few months on it once he discovered he was not strong enough to train in the Heart Kingdom, Magna had devised a way to literally even the odds against any powerful opponent.

This new spell attaches their souls to one another, so Dante couldn’t even break it for as long as Magna held out. This splits their magic in half, and pretty much makes them even. Though Dante’s magic and devil abilities mean he doesn’t go down easily, Magna gambles on the fact that he’d be able to survive in the fight long enough for Dante to run out of magic. And that he does, as Magna catches Dante by surprise by truly making him realize the reality of what it’s like for someone weak.

Black Clover Shows Off Magna’s True Spirit With This Win

Black Clover Season 2 has been hyping up this Magna fight with its newest opening theme sequence , and it’s with good reason as it was the fight fans had been waiting to see the most from the Spade Kingdom Raid arc overall. Magna had been in a rivalry with Luck and Asta at the very beginning, but the two of them quickly outpaced him as their fights got more intense. Which ultimately makes Magna an even bigger reflection of the core principles of the series were effort and guts can triumph over latent talent.

Magna working on this new spell and completely making a fool out of someone who disrespected him due to that lack of magic is an all-encompassing thematic victory for the character in Black Clover. Regardless of the fights to come in the rest of the season and in the anime’s future with the final arc , this is truly the biggest win. What did you think of Magna’s big fight in Black Clover Season 2 after nine long years? Let us know your thoughts about it all in the comments.
